row.jobSummary:
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

As a Specialist, you build brand loyalty and create owners of Apple products and services. You’re dedicated to selling and delivering a customer service experience that is unlike any other. A Specialist is curious — you ask questions to learn about our customers’ needs, customizing recommendations to enrich their lives.

detail.description:
Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products. 

Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apple’s products, services, purchase options, and Product Zone sales processes.

Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apple’s products, services, and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities.

Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.

Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn. 

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.
detail.preferredQualifications:
You can:
Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services. 
Personalize solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apple’s core values.
detail.minimumQualifications: You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

en_US.name: Pay & Benefits
en_US.content:
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

For information about pay, if you are interested in roles located in one of our California, Colorado, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, New Jersey, Ohio, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, or Washington DC locations select a store and view pay information.

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

row.jobSummary:
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. Our team is a diverse and nimble group that manages Apple’s retail stores, workplaces, and workplace services. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world. 
The Facilities team within Places is responsible for creating spaces that represent Apple’s worldwide reputation, fostering an environment that inspires. You’ll work with cutting-edge building automation technology across a diverse portfolio of facilities, and the work you do will directly impact the comfort, safety, and productivity of thousands of Apple employees and customers.
We are seeking someone who is motivated to join our team as a BMS Controls Specialist to maintain our existing systems and continue to create more as we grow.

detail.description:
The BMS Controls Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day monitoring, maintenance, troubleshooting, and optimization of building automation and control systems across the facilities portfolio. This role ensures reliable operation of HVAC, chiller plants, fire alarm systems, and other critical building infrastructure through direct work on BMS platforms and field-level controls.
As a BMS Controls Specialist, you will strive to maintain the systems that operate to the best of their ability, identifying issues and creating solutions. You will work closely with other Places teams, such as Project Management, to maintain our high standards as new infrastructure is brought online.
detail.responsibilities:
Monitor, operate, and maintain building management systems (BMS) including HVAC controls, chiller plant automation, lighting controls, and energy management systems
Program, configure, and troubleshoot DDC (Direct Digital Control) controllers, sensors, actuators, and related field devices
Respond to BMS alarms and system faults — diagnose root cause, implement corrective actions, and document resolution
Perform preventive maintenance on control system hardware and software, including firmware updates, calibration, and network health checks
Monitor and optimize chiller plant sequences, air handling unit operations, and VAV systems for energy efficiency and occupant comfort
Support fire alarm system monitoring, inspection coordination, and interface with life safety infrastructure
Maintain accurate as-built documentation, point schedules, control sequences, and system drawings
Coordinate with mechanical, electrical, and fire protection trades during commissioning, retrofits, and tenant improvement projects
Generate and analyze trend data, energy reports, and system performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities
Participate in after-hours on-call rotation for critical system alarms and emergencies
detail.preferredQualifications:
Associate's degree or technical certification in HVAC, controls, electrical, or a related field
Niagara 4 certification (Tridium)
Experience with energy management and analytics platforms
Knowledge of IT networking fundamentals (IP addressing, VLANs, switch configuration) as applied to BMS networks
OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification
detail.minimumQualifications:
Minimum **3 years** of hands-on experience with building automation / BMS controls (e.g., Siemens, Johnson Controls, Honeywell, Tridium/Niagara, Schneider Electric)
Working knowledge of HVAC mechanical systems, chiller plant operations, and air-side/water-side control sequences
Experience with DDC programming, BACnet/IP, and Modbus communication protocols
Familiarity with fire alarm systems and NFPA 72 inspection/testing requirements
Ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and controls drawings
Strong troubleshooting skills across both hardware (controllers, sensors, wiring) and software (graphics, programming, network)
Comfortable working from ladders, in mechanical rooms, and above ceilings

row.jobSummary:
The Asset Intelligence Platform is the consolidated registry that maps applications and services to their underlying infrastructure and dependencies across our data centers, compute facilities, and labs, spanning both internal and third-party environments. By aggregating data from dozens of integrations and discovery tools, it forms the information backbone for operational excellence, IT service management, software asset management, and critical security, privacy, and compliance programs.

In any large, evolving infrastructure, visibility is the foundation for everything that follows. Teams responsible for security, compliance, and reliability depend on accurate, comprehensive insight into the environment to do their jobs effectively, and this platform delivers it. As the Application Engineer in this role, you won't just keep the system running—you'll help it evolve alongside the infrastructure and the stakeholders who rely on it.

detail.description:
We are seeking an Application Engineer who operates at the intersection of customer need and engineering execution. In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of the problems internal customers face, translate those insights into product direction, onboard new teams onto the platform, support established users, and help stakeholders at every level understand the business value this system delivers.

This is a role for someone who wants meaningful influence over both the what and the how of a product, and who values the people using a system as much as the system itself.
detail.responsibilities:
Customer Discovery and Advocacy Build strong relationships with the internal teams and business partners who depend on IT inventory data for security, compliance, operations, and planning. Understand their workflows, challenges, and goals, and ensure those insights inform every decision the engineering team makes.
Product Roadmap Development Play a significant role in defining and prioritizing the product roadmap. Drawing on customer feedback, usage data, and your own technical judgment, help determine what the team builds next and ensure investments are aligned with the highest-impact opportunities.
Technical Collaboration with Engineering Participate actively in design reviews, architectural discussions, and engineering tradeoff decisions. Bring a product lens to technical conversations by consistently grounding them in real customer problems. You should be comfortable reading and reviewing code, prototyping solutions, and building integrations when the situation calls for it.
Customer Onboarding Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for new teams, users, and business partners. This includes assessing their requirements, configuring or tailoring solutions, developing documentation, leading enablement sessions, and ensuring successful adoption.
Ongoing Customer Support Serve as a trusted point of contact for teams already using the platform. Triage issues, collect feedback, identify patterns that signal deeper systemic needs, and close the loop so customers know their input has been heard and acted upon.
Storytelling and Value Communication Help the team articulate the business value of the IT Inventory platform to leadership, stakeholders, and partner organizations. Whether through a strategy document, a quarterly review, or a cross-functional presentation, make a clear and compelling case for the platform's impact and direction.
detail.preferredQualifications:
Familiarity with IT operations concepts such as asset management, configuration management, or CMDB tools
Exposure to security, privacy, and compliance frameworks
Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to operate effectively across a broad and evolving set of responsibilities
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences
detail.minimumQualifications:
6+ years of experience in a role combining technical depth with customer or product engagement, such as solutions engineering, technical product management, application engineering, or a comparable discipline
Strong understanding of infrastructure and platform engineering, including data centers, cloud environments, networking, compute, and the services built on top of them
Technical fluency sufficient to read and review code, write scripts or prototypes, work with APIs and data models, and contribute meaningfully to architecture discussions
Demonstrated ability to build trust with customers, understand their needs deeply, and communicate solutions clearly
Strong product instincts, including the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, assess impact, and prioritize based on customer and business value
BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a technical related field, or international degree equivalent
